items.prompt: A dark bedroom before dawn in a small city apartment. A man of about forty sleeps on his left side under a light blanket, one palm under his cheek, seen from behind and from a distance, his face in shadow. A white ceiling with one thin crack running from the corner to a plain ceiling lamp. Faint streetlight on the wall.

alt.ru: Тёмная спальня: мужчина спит на левом боку, подложив ладонь под щёку, на белом потолке тонкая трещина от угла к люстре.
alt.en: A dark bedroom: a man asleep on his left side, his palm under his cheek, a thin crack in the white ceiling running from the corner to the lamp.
alt.pt: Um quarto escuro: um homem dorme sobre o lado esquerdo, com a mão debaixo do rosto, no teto branco uma rachadura fina do canto até o lustre.
alt.es: Un dormitorio oscuro: un hombre duerme sobre el lado izquierdo, con la mano bajo la mejilla, en el techo blanco una grieta fina de la esquina a la lámpara.

caption.ru: Он заснул в начале четвёртого. Ночью память открыта настежь.
caption.en: He fell asleep a little after three. At night memory stands wide open.
caption.pt: Ele adormeceu pouco depois das três. De noite a memória fica escancarada.
caption.es: Se durmió poco después de las tres. De noche la memoria está abierta de par en par.

items.prompt: The same small city-apartment kitchen in late-morning light: a small square table, raised horizontal blinds, an old rounded white refrigerator with a single souvenir magnet showing a tiny mosque. A man of about forty, seen from behind at the table, holds a phone to his ear and looks down at his other hand, open on the table. Beside it a cup of coffee going cold and a coffee tin with a chipped rim.

alt.ru: Утро на кухне: мужчина спиной к нам говорит по телефону и смотрит на свою раскрытую ладонь, рядом остывает кофе.
alt.en: Morning in the kitchen: a man with his back to us talks on the phone and looks at his open palm, coffee going cold beside it.
alt.pt: Manhã na cozinha: um homem de costas fala ao celular e olha para a palma aberta da mão, ao lado um café esfriando.
alt.es: Mañana en la cocina: un hombre de espaldas habla por teléfono y mira su palma abierta, al lado un café que se enfría.

caption.ru: За сорок минут он одиннадцать раз спросил её, кто она. Одиннадцать раз она ответила.
caption.en: In forty minutes he asked her eleven times who she was. Eleven times she answered.
caption.pt: Em quarenta minutos ele perguntou onze vezes quem ela era. Onze vezes ela respondeu.
caption.es: En cuarenta minutos le preguntó once veces quién era. Once veces ella contestó.
